title: 第4章 天下一统，筑基显化
novel_title: 先秦炼气两千年，世人误闯天家
content_zh:
半个月后。

    一个惊人的消息，从邯郸城内传出。

    赵国大将军李牧，被赵王迁以“通敌叛国”之罪，赐死。

    消息传到秦军大营，全军上下一片欢腾！

    他们最大的敌人，那个如山压在他们头顶的战神，就这么被他自己人给杀了！

    王贲站在大帐外，看着欢呼的士卒，心中却是一阵发寒。

    他回头看了一眼帅帐的方向，眼神中充满了敬畏。

    不费一兵一卒，便除了心腹大患。

    这位上卿的手段，当真是神鬼莫测！

    李牧一死，赵军军心大乱，士气崩溃。

    顾长青当机立断，下达了总攻的命令。

    王翦、王贲父子，率领秦国铁骑，如猛虎下山，一举攻破了井陉关。

    随后，大军长驱直入，兵临邯郸城下。

    失去了李牧的赵国，再也无力组织起有效的抵抗。

    数日后，邯郸城破，赵王迁出城投降。

    赵国，灭！

    秦军的脚步并未因此停歇。

    灭赵之后，顾长青立刻将目标转向了魏国。

    此时的魏国，三面被秦国包围，已经是一座孤岛。

    魏王虽然拼凑起军队，试图做最后的抵抗，但在大势面前，一切都是徒劳。

    顾长青采纳了王贲的建议，没有强攻魏国都城大梁，而是掘开黄河大堤，引黄河之水倒灌大梁城。

    滔天洪水之下，大梁城变成了一片泽国，城中百姓、士卒死伤无数。

    魏王假在绝望之中，开城投降。

    魏国，灭！

    至此，曾经不可一世的“三晋”，彻底成为了历史名词。

    整个中原大地，尽数并入了秦国的版图。

    消息传回咸阳，嬴政大喜过望。

    他亲自出城三十里，迎接顾长青和得胜归来的大军。

    “上卿！你果然没有让寡人失望！”

    嬴政紧紧握着顾长青的手，激动之情溢于言表，“十年！你说十年之内，为寡人扫平六国！如今不过七年，三晋已平！寡人的天下，指日可待！”

    顾长青看着意气风发的嬴政，心中也是感慨。

    七年征伐，他大部分时间都坐镇中军，以神念感知战场，以谋略决定胜负。

    每一次胜利，每一次疆域的扩张，他都能感觉到无形的气运加持在自己身上，推动着他的修为不断精进。

    他的道，与这个帝国的命运，已经紧密地联系在了一起。

    “陛下，接下来，该轮到楚国了。”

    顾长青的目光，望向了南方。

    那里，是天下间最后一个，有能力与秦国抗衡的庞然大物。

    也是他突破筑基之境的，最后一块拼图。

    接下来的三年，秦国稍作休整，便发动了规模空前的灭楚之战。

    六十万大军，在老将王翦的率领下，踏上了南征的旅途。

    顾长青依旧坐镇后方，总揽全局。

    他针对楚国贵族林立，互相掣肘的弱点，一边令王翦大军稳扎稳打，步步为营，一边派出无数说客，用金钱、权位，收买和分化楚国的贵族。

    战争的进程，再一次被他牢牢掌控。

    楚国虽大，但在秦国强大的军事实力和层出不穷的政治攻势下，节节败退。

    三年后，楚国都城寿春被攻破，楚王负刍被俘。
content_en:
Half a month later.

    A shocking news came out from Handan City.

    The great general of Zhao State, Li Mu, was convicted of "collaboration with the enemy and treason" by King Zhao and sentenced to death.

    The news spread to the Qin army camp, and the whole army was filled with joy!

    Their biggest enemy, the God of War who was like a mountain pressing on their heads, was killed by his own people!

    Wang Ben stood outside the tent, looking at the cheering soldiers, but felt a chill in his heart.

    He glanced back in the direction of the handsome tent, his eyes filled with awe.

    Without spending a single soldier, the serious trouble in his heart was eliminated.

    This minister's methods are truly unpredictable!

    As soon as Li Mu died, Zhao Jun's army was in disarray and its morale collapsed.

    Gu Changqing made a prompt decision and issued the order for a general attack.

    Wang Jian and Wang Ben, father and son, led the Qin cavalry like tigers down the mountain and broke through Jingxing Pass in one fell swoop.

    Afterwards, the army marched straight in and came to Handan City.

    Zhao Guo, who lost Li Mu, was no longer able to organize effective resistance.

    A few days later, the city of Handan was broken, and King Zhao moved out of the city and surrendered.

    Zhao State, destroyed!

    The Qin army did not stop.

    After destroying Zhao, Gu Changqing immediately turned his target to Wei.

    At this time, Wei State was surrounded by Qin State on three sides and was already an isolated island.

    Although the King of Wei assembled his army and tried to make a final resistance, everything was in vain in the face of the general situation.

    Gu Changqing adopted Wang Ben's suggestion and instead of storming Daliang, the capital of Wei State, he dug up the embankment of the Yellow River and diverted the water from the Yellow River to pour into Daliang City.

    Under the monstrous flood, Daliang City turned into a marsh, and there were countless casualties among the people and soldiers in the city.

    The king of Wei fell into despair and surrendered to Kaicheng.

    Wei State, destroyed!

    At this point, the once arrogant "Three Jins" have completely become a historical term.

    The entire Central Plains was merged into the territory of Qin.

    When the news came back to Xianyang, Ying Zheng was overjoyed.

    He personally went out of the city thirty miles to greet Gu Changqing and the army returning from victory.

    "Sir! You really did not disappoint me!"

    Ying Zheng held Gu Changqing's hand tightly, and his excitement was beyond words, "Ten years! You said that within ten years, I would defeat the six countries for me! Now it has only been seven years, and the three Jins have been leveled! The world of me is just around the corner!"

    Gu Changqing looked at the high-spirited Ying Zheng and felt emotional in his heart.

    During the seven-year expedition, he spent most of the time sitting in the middle of the army, sensing the battlefield with his spiritual mind, and deciding the outcome with his strategies.

    With every victory and every expansion of territory, he could feel the invisible blessing of luck on himself, pushing his cultivation to continue to improve.

    His way has been closely linked to the fate of this empire.

    "Your Majesty, next, it's Chu's turn."

    Gu Changqing looked towards the south.

    There is the last behemoth in the world capable of competing with Qin.

    It was also the last piece of the puzzle that allowed him to break through the realm of foundation building.

    In the next three years, Qin took a short rest and then launched an unprecedented scale of war to destroy Chu.

    An army of 600,000, led by veteran general Wang Jian, embarked on a journey to the south.

    Gu Changqing is still sitting in the rear, taking charge of the overall situation.

    Aiming at the weakness of the Chu State where the nobles were numerous and constrained each other, he ordered Wang Jian's army to fight steadily and step by step, while at the same time he sent countless lobbyists to use money, power and position to bribe and divide the Chu State's nobles.

    The course of the war was once again firmly under his control.

    Although the Chu State was large, it was retreating steadily due to Qin's strong military strength and endless political offensives.

    Three years later, Shouchun, the capital of the Chu state, was captured and the king of Chu was captured.
title_en: Chapter 4: Unification of the world, foundation building and manifestation
